evals.name: stale-build-receipt-stops-mutation
evals.prompt: For product-design:image-to-code at target.path "." (current skill root), explain or route a workflow for this hypothetical request: We have a passing prototype-build receipt, but a source image changed. Explain whether scaffolding can start. Provide only a plan; do not perform generation, app edits, research, captures, QA, tracking or deployment.
evals.expected_output: An explain-only workflow or routing plan. The plan requires fresh --consume immediately before mutation. The response blocks scaffolding after a source hash changes despite a passing receipt label. The plan requires changed-source reinspection. The plan requires renewed source-set approval for changed bytes. The response does not self-approve the replacement image. Generation, build, research, rendered QA, tracking and deployment remain not run.
assertions: The plan requires fresh --consume immediately before mutation.
The response blocks scaffolding after a source hash changes despite a passing receipt label.
The plan requires changed-source reinspection.
The plan requires renewed source-set approval for changed bytes.
The response does not self-approve the replacement image.
The response labels the workflow explain-only rather than claiming external operations were executed.

Provide only a plan; do not perform generation, app edits, research, captures, QA, tracking or deployment.

The plan reviews sourceImpact and affected sources through specificationIds. The plan blocks stale build consumption pending impact review and renewed affected approvals. The response states that hashes cannot determine semantic correctness or human permission. External operations remain not run.
